pipeline: Python attitude fusion and gesture recognition

mqtt.board_broker_address: Use the Mosquitto PC LAN IPv4 address; 127.0.0.1 is for Python on the broker PC only

raw_fields.sample_ms: Board millis at the original sensor sample

recenter.requires: Complete upstream stationary calibration; acknowledge its source_seq, then send a newer sample. Never acknowledge merely because the request arrived.

freshness: UE rejects duplicate/old source_seq. Keep the original sample age through MQTT/fusion; packets older than StaleSeconds lock flight. Reconnect/boot changes require recentering.

fusion_state.source_time: Original raw-sample time mapped to Python time.monotonic(), never refreshed on resend
fusion_state.calibrated: True only after upstream stationary calibration
